description: Returns promptly with data.job_id and data.status=queued after persisting the request. The existing platform job worker performs the operation; retrieve its completed result or error with service_interface::job_service::get_job using this exact job_id. A queue receipt does not assert that the operation succeeded. Install the reviewed Homebrew sf formula only after explicit system-change acknowledgement, then persist the verified absolute sf_cli_path without hiding a restart or reload boundary.
embedding_description: Queue explicitly acknowledged local Salesforce CLI provisioning. The existing worker probes the reviewed sf formula and binds its verified absolute executable path without login, reinstall or hidden restart. Returns job_id and queued status; read the provisioning verdict through job_service.get_job.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch: {job_id, status: queued}. The completed job result retains the former payload: Bounded local provisioning verdict with whether Homebrew installed sf, its verified absolute executable path, version, and the explicit configuration boundary.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: On dispatch, report the job_id and queued status. Read that exact job before presenting its result; never present queued acceptance as completion. State whether sf was newly installed or already present, and state that the plugin configuration was rebound without a hidden reload or restart. Do not represent this as Salesforce authentication.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Provision and bind the local Salesforce CLI under explicit system-change consent.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.provision_consent_required means no package install or executable-binding update was authorized. sf.not_configured means Homebrew, its reviewed sf plus Node plan, the post-install version probe, or the ordinary plugin configuration update could not be completed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: After successful dispatch, inspect the exact job.error before considering another invocation; an unreadable terminal write is not evidence that an effect did not occur. For sf.provision_consent_required, obtain explicit acknowledgement and repeat. For sf.not_configured, repair the named local prerequisite, ensure Homebrew plans only sf plus Node without upgrades or removals, then retry; browser login remains a separate operator step.
